thread:
Priya Rao: Quick weekly check-in for Atlas / Nimbus / Ridgeway — focusing on token usage + throughput QoW / QoQ and renewal flags. TL;DR: Atlas +12% WoW tokens (+28% QoQ), Nimbus flat WoW (-9% QoQ), Ridgeway -18% WoW (-35% QoQ).

Priya Rao: Latency note: Atlas p95 jumped ~120ms (now ~420ms). Error rate for Atlas went from 0.3% -> 1.2% over the last 48h. Nimbus stable. Ridgeway has a steady drop in usage + a support ticket complaining about timeouts.

Priya Rao: Dashboards: <https://redwood.app/d/usage/account-overview?account=atlas> (Atlas), <https://redwood.app/d/usage/account-overview?account=ridgeway> (Ridgeway).

Ethan Cole: Ack. Any infra or model changes this week that could explain Atlas regression?

Priya Rao: No infra deploys. We did swap Atlas to a quantized variant two days ago (redwood-3b -> redwood-3b-quant) for cost testing.

Maya Lin: Quant variants can cause cache pressure with small continuous-batch sizes. Can you paste the model serving config?

Priya Rao: Sure — snippet from the rollout: 
```
model: redwood-3b-quant
batching: continuous
target_batch_size: 4
kv_cache: enabled
max_seq_len: 1024
quant_profile: int8
```

Samir Patel: Routing logs show retry spikes for Atlas, 504s up ~0.6% of requests in the same window. Suggest trying target_batch_size=8 and enabling prefix cache warmup for Atlas production route as a low-risk mitigation.

Priya Rao: Noted. I'll schedule a canary rollback at 15:30 PT today if we don't see improvement after config tweak. Also flagging Ridgeway as a renewal risk — usage down QoQ and negative sentiment from support thread. Renewal date in ~3 weeks.

CS Bot: :warning: Ridgeway renewal in 21 days. Renewal risk score updated -> MED-HIGH. (owner: customer-success)

Maya Lin: I'll reach out to Ridgeway CSM to set up an enablement call + request failing traces. Can someone export the top 10 slow traces for Ridgeway and Atlas?

Priya Rao: Exported trace IDs: trace_2026_01_02_991, trace_2026_01_03_432, trace_2026_01_04_777. Putting them in the shared folder: <https://redwood.app/files/traces/week-9>.

Ethan Cole: Quick mitigation plan for Atlas: 1) increase pooling (dedicated workers) for the heavy tenants, 2) bump batch_size to 8 for the quant variant, 3) add fallback to non-quant model when p95 > 500ms. I'll open a PR for (3) now.

Samir Patel: I'll try batch_size=8 on canary and enable prefix cache warmup. Will monitor retries and p95 for the next 30m.

Priya Rao: Spend note: Atlas spend +20% WoW (expected from usage uptick), Nimbus -3% WoW, Ridgeway -42% WoW (risk).

Priya Rao: Action items:
- Ethan: PR for fallback + monitor (p95 threshold).
- Samir: batch_size bump + prefix cache warmup on Atlas canary.
- Maya: Enablement + customer call for Ridgeway, gather traces.
- CS: Watch renewal thread and prepare slide for execs if score stays MED-HIGH.

Priya Rao: Reconvene Friday 09:30 PT to confirm status. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

Ethan Cole: On it.

Maya Lin: Will follow up with the CSM and post notes here after the call.

Samir Patel: Canary updated -> batch_size=8, prefix warmup enabled. Monitoring logs now.

Priya Rao: Great — keep updates short here. If p95 drops <20% by EOD we can keep quant rollout; otherwise we rollback.

CS Bot: Note: Added "renewal-risk" tag to Ridgeway thread and scheduled reminder in 7 days.
